visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host wearing a grey work shirt and a black backward baseball cap stands in a workshop. The background is a wall densely packed with power tools, batteries, and equipment. A floating inset window on the left side of the frame displays a photo of singer Justin Bieber next to a blue modified Ferrari. Bright studio lighting illuminates the host and the environment. (2) The host gestures with his hands while explaining that money alone cannot buy a Ferrari. The inset window changes to show electronic musician Deadmau5 and his famous blue Nyan Cat-themed 'Purrari.' A brief montage features a high-angle shot of hands signing legal documents and a wooden gavel resting on a desk, representing legal action. (3) The scene returns to the host in a medium shot as he discusses the brand's design philosophy. A high-quality shot of a green and white Ferrari 296 GTB is displayed in a studio setting, showcasing its aerodynamic profile and white racing stripes. The camera remains static on the host. (4) A low-angle cinematic shot features a red Ferrari LaFerrari with its butterfly doors raised. The host concludes by stating that Ferrari prefers customers who appreciate cars as art. A YouTube logo and the handle '超認真少年' appear at the bottom as part of the permanent overlay.
